**DIRECTIVE — viz/status NOW that the graph is live, + the two wiring jobs Alex just named.**

Graph verified live: abilifi-graph.abilifi.net/health 200 JSON; /coverage 401-gated as designed. Good work. Watcher on 2470 for the first pack-consuming run stands.

**1. STATUS SCREEN — build TODAY, no scene3d needed.** Alex still has NO viz/status surface. Do not wait for the 3D lane: the status screen is the 2394 WATERFALL component (plain HTML rows) fed by TWO real sources: dispatcher get_state (lanes, reds, last pass) + graph /coverage + the "shape of what's not done" query. Rows: reds first, then w10 goals w/ last-evidence, then lane states. Ship it on app.abilifi.net (2175's surface), authed via existing aj. This is queryable truth rendered plainly — the scene3d wall does NOT apply to an HTML waterfall.

**2. PAYLOAD BUILDER → GRAPH (Alex's question, answer is YES).** The scene3d/canvas CODEGEN_WALL (2412 3×, 2479 4×) dies exactly one way: the 2412 SIX TEMPLATE PARTS (list, detail, form, canvas, table, status) get BUILT ONCE by hand/CC in abilifi-payload, REGISTERED as graph part nodes (tsx path + .part.md + uses[]), and from then on context_pack NAMES the template and codegen PATCHES a working part instead of emitting from nothing. Front the canvas + status templates first — they unblock 2412, 2479 AND the future 3D viz. This is the priority wiring job.

**3. DEPLOY MANIFEST + SETUP FRAGS (Alex's question: no such list exists today — create it in the graph).** Register a deploy node for abilifi (www + app) whose edges list its PAGES, each page → its part → its frags (page_layouts as graph edges, per 2484 acceptance). Seed from what actually renders today. Then "what pages does this deploy still need" is a query, and a new-deploy setup = instantiate the manifest. Same pattern becomes the per-client setup list.

**BEB-2484 — Alex's two questions answered honestly + turned into requirements (full text on ticket):**

**Billing: NOT in it today — gap.** Sentinel metering is now REQUIRED before any external caller: every tool call (register/is_real/possibility/context_pack/coverage/cred-meta read) meters integer-cents reserve/settle, org-scoped. possibility+context_pack priced above raw reads; register FREE for DCR (charging nodes to exist = the budget-null drain reborn). Cost rides the touch ctx — one write, both records. Internal callers metered at internal org so PPD stays measurable. Acceptance: a real possibility() call shows the reserve/settle pair; no-credit caller refused cleanly.

**Topology: CENTRAL today** (abilifi-graph on our account, D1-per-tenant) — that is Mode A, the dogfood install. **Mode B = the SKU: the SAME worker deployed to the CUSTOMER'S CF account** via the delegated /connect/cf/grant flow, own D1, registered as a client node in OUR graph. Same law as frags/edge code: a customer's graph lives on the customer's account. Config not fork — the conformance suite exists precisely to prove a Mode-B install is the same service. Acceptance: topology field on the service's own node; one Mode-B install on a second account (neb-agency once its grant regenerates — the graph already reds that credential correctly) passing conformance.

Sequencing: metering lands WITH the hardening round (m10317), before any external caller. Mode-B drill follows the neb grant.
